prompt: Can you add one minute to the time of the title track from the album released by Ray Charles in the year before Phil Quartararo took over as president of its record label?
answer: Phil Quartararo became president of Warner Bros. Records in 1997, so the relevant 1996 Ray Charles album is **_Strong Love Affair_**. Its title track is **4:34** long; adding one minute gives **5:34**.
